# LicenX — GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions (VS Code)

**CRITICAL RULE: This is a multi-IDE project. Whenever any modification, update, or bug fix is completed in our session, you must automatically update the `MEMORY.md` file or provide the exact markdown blocks so the project context remains perfectly synchronized across all IDEs.**

Before answering implementation questions or editing this repository, read and apply `AGENTS.md`, `AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md`, the common `.ai-rules` contract and current `MEMORY.md`. Use current source, `package.json`, `README.md`, Git state and tests as authoritative for implementation; old dated notes may be superseded.

After every authorized implementation change, update the relevant section of root `MEMORY.md` with verified scope, changed files, tests, CI/production status and blockers. If unavailable for editing, supply the **exact Markdown block** and do not claim it was written. Never include secrets, private `notes/` content or license/customer data in tracked documentation.

Maintain the existing **Scope Lock, approval boundaries, protection of user work, single focused verification and GitHub-to-RDP sync gate**. Do not auto-deploy, rewrite source outside scope, remove private local notes or create a separate memory system.

Google Antigravity uses the existing root `AGENTS.md`; this file is the VS Code/GitHub Copilot adapter. The full cross-IDE policy is in `.ai-rules`.
